items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: everybody saw Sass was really thrilled by her

ctx.x: Sarah Vaughan was a tremendous voice. Sarah Vaughan, every time she sang, hair go step up on your body, neck, and all that stuff. Dinah did that to me, first time I heard her, too, because I was listening to Catholic music, choir and all that kind of stuff. I heard all the stuff, Baptist music and all that stuff, but Dinah really brought back – I was about to shout, and I didn’t know what it was. I said, whoa, something’s happening here that I never felt before. Those ladies could put something on you that you’re…
How much time did you spend with her?
